messages.subject: Error deploying app
parts:
Yesterday I made my first attempt to publish an app on shinyapps.io. All went well until I tried to deploy my app. It gave the error:
 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 30747059 failed: Error parsing manifest: Unsupported locale: nl_NA.UTF-8
 
I have no idea what it means. I updated Rsudio, updated R, reinstalled shinyapps (0.3.63). But that didn't help.
Does anybody have an idea?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error deploying app
parts:
This should be fixed. Please update your shinyapps package by doing:

devtools::install_github('shinyapps')

You will then need to run:

shinyapps:::detectLocale.Windows(FALSE)

And then redeploy your application.

-Andy
